name: Solar Flare Bonsai Grove
description: Miniature bonsai trees whose leaves are tiny solar flares, each pulse releasing a warm golden glow.
prompt: A serene Japanese garden with rows of bonsai trees. Instead of normal leaves, each branch tip bursts with miniature solar flares — tiny, dynamic arcs of plasma glowing gold and orange. The ground is raked sand with subtle light patterns. Macro photography style, high detail, warm color palette, peaceful yet energetic.
caption: Tiny trees, cosmic hearts 🌞🌳 #SolarBonsai
